langsDescription: Comma-separated list of codeblock languages to enable preview button for (e.g. flow,mermaid,sequence)
previewModeDescription: Which viewer the preview button opens: a floating window or the fullscreen overlay
fullscreenCloseHint: Click on the dark area to close, wheel to zoom, drag to pan
floatingWidthDescription: Initial width (in % of viewport width) of the floating preview window (default 45)
floatingHeightDescription: Initial height (in % of viewport height) of the floating preview window (default 60)
